Users can receive these updates via Telegram, GitHub, RSS, or a custom bot without needing to keep a browser tab open.
projects.name: Squeek Alerts

projects.description_en: Burrow Power is a neon survival game where you protect Pip's underground home through six illustrated encounters. You read each threat and choose a response to keep the nest, garden, and tunnels above zero until sunrise. The game's challenges are shaped by real Squeekchain wheel activity.
projects.name: Burrow Power

projects.description_en: Crypto Hamster Run is an endless runner game where players control a hamster to jump, slide and shoot obstacles. Passing obstacles mines blocks, with near misses and combos providing bonuses. A boss appears every 500 blocks, requiring weapons to defeat.
projects.name: Crypto Hamster Run

projects.description_en: Wheel Merge is an arcade game where you drop hamsters into a turning wheel and merge matching neighbours to beat the timer. The game's speed follows the live Squeekchain hamster wheel, and completed blocks grant a joker token.
projects.name: Wheel Merge

projects.description_en: Users can generate names in various styles, collect likes, and receive SQK tips. The site displays real-time hamster activity and weekly leaderboards.
projects.name: Squeek 起名屋

projects.description_en: SqueekScope is a command center for the Squeekchain testnet that displays live network metrics. It tracks block height, difficulty, active power, and SQK token issuance. Users can monitor round progress and verify ledger integrity through real-time data snapshots.
projects.name: SqueekScope

projects.description_en: SqueekVision is a live dashboard for the SqueekChain network. It displays Squeektoshi's wheel status, block progress, $SQK supply, and settlement data. The page refreshes every 15 seconds to show real-time activity on Sepolia.
projects.name: SqueekVision

projects.description_en: Squeek Clicker is a 60-second pixel mouse clicker game for the Squeekchain community. Players click a mouse to build a 5x combo and chase their personal best score.
projects.name: Squeek Clicker

projects.description_en: A browser-based tool for building custom OBS overlays for Squeekchain streams. You can arrange widgets to display live wheel telemetry, settled blocks, and recent events. The editor runs entirely in the browser without requiring a wallet or account.
projects.name: Squeek Studio

projects.description_en: Ghost Wheel lets you race against a replay of Squeektoshi's real recorded wheel runs. You spin an on-screen wheel using your mouse, trackpad, finger, or arrow keys. The game counts your passages using the WHEELY9000's specific rules and displays his actual Squeek blocks at the corresponding moments.
projects.name: Ghost Wheel

projects.description_en: Mint a free on-chain pixel hamster on Sepolia. Its art changes to show running, napping, or sleeping based on Squeekchain's wheel activity.
projects.name: Squeek Companion

projects.description_en: Squeek & Glide is a 2D flying game where a real Squeekchain hamster powers the wind. You tap to fly, dodge cardboard obstacles, and collect Golden Seeds for double points.
projects.name: Squeek & Glide

projects.description_en: Squeek Express is a hamster-powered railway game where you wake your engineer, choose cargo, and deliver it across the valley. You can build a crew of hamsters to gather resources like gears and crystals while exploring different routes. The game offers separate Practice and Squeekchain Live modes for saving progress.
projects.name: Squeek Express

projects.description_en: Squeek City is a top-down, retro GTA-style open-world game where you play as a hamster exploring a pixel city. Squeektoshi's real-time wheel activity controls the day-night cycle, city busyness, and loot availability, with new blocks dropping collectible seeds. You can drive vehicles, complete missions, and evade police in a 5-star wanted system.
projects.name: Squeek City

projects.description_en: Squeek Runner is a game where speed and score are controlled by Squeektoshi's real wheel activity. Players tap or press space to jump, and the final score can be recorded on Sepolia via a transaction.
projects.name: Squeek Runner

projects.description_en: The Wheelpaper turns the Squeekchain whitepaper into an interactive site where you can adjust difficulty and block counts to see how the chain works. It implements the document's integer formulas in the browser and compares them against live Sepolia data. A pixel wheel on the page spins at Squeektoshi's real RPM, stopping when the hamster sleeps.
projects.name: The Wheelpaper

projects.description_en: Squeek Sprint is an endless runner where the game speed matches Squeektoshi's live wheel RPM. The course layout is generated from the latest Squeekchain settlement hash, ensuring all players face the same jumps and gaps. You control a character to jump, duck, and collect seeds while trying to keep pace with the hamster.
projects.name: Squeek Sprint

projects.description_en: A theatrical OBS overlay and second-screen ghost race driven by the real Squeekchain hamster wheel. A cartoon hamster performs on a velvet-curtained stage, with every action sourced from the wheel's live telemetry. It serves as a free community stream companion for Squeekchain Genesis Code.
projects.name: WHEELY Stage

projects.description_en: Wheel Canvas creates live, deterministic dot-grid paintings from every turn of Squeektoshi's wheel on Squeekchain. Each day produces a unique visual record of the hamster's activity, offering a simple way to observe the chain's real-time data through art.
projects.name: Wheel Canvas

projects.description_en: Hamster Nap is a community game where players buy NAP tokens to become the last buyer before Squeektoshi naps. A 2% fee from each purchase builds a pot of test ETH, which the final buyer wins when the hamster's nap is certified. The game runs as a Uniswap v4 hook on the Sepolia testnet.
projects.name: Hamster Nap (NAP)

projects.description_en: Hamster Nap 3D is a community game on Squeekchain where buying NAP tokens contributes to a shared ETH prize pool. A Uniswap v4 hook tracks the last buyer before SqueekCore certifies a nap, settling the pot to that participant. The project runs on the Sepolia testnet with tokens that have no real value.
projects.name: Hamster Nap 3D (NAP)

projects.description_en: A hamster-cam companion for Squeekchain that displays live stats on Squeektoshi's wheel activity, including speed, distance, and block height. Users can connect a wallet to send a zero-allowance transaction, which serves as a simple test for interacting with the chain.
projects.name: Squeek Pit Crew

projects.description_en: NutshellMarkets is a treasury project built to support the growth of Squeekchain. It functions as a financial reserve intended to sustain and expand the ecosystem.
projects.name: NutshellMarkets

projects.description_en: Among Squeeks is a social deduction game where players mine blocks and identify a secret Rugger. The gameplay is driven by Squeektoshi, a real hamster whose wheel activity powers the chain. You can play against AI hamsters or invite friends to join the crew.
projects.name: Among Squeeks

projects.description_en: SQUEEKDANCE is a one-button rhythm game where the beat is set by the live speed of Squeektoshi's wheel. Players tap when a gold star hits 12 to fill a dance wall with friends. Anyone can press a settled round onchain to etch their name on the record.
projects.name: SQUEEKDANCE

projects.description_en: Squeeky Market is a play-money prediction market where users bet on Squeektoshi's daily wheel distance. It features live telemetry, signed orders, and on-chain settlement for winner claims. The project is currently in MVP stage with plans to expand to other Squeek ecosystem predictions.
projects.name: Squeeky Market

projects.description_en: Squeekfolio is a read-only tool for viewing Squeekchain Genesis profiles. Look up a wallet to see its Squeek NFT levels, claimable SQK, and clout badges. It provides a simple home for exploring your Squeeks and staking rewards.
projects.name: Squeekfolio

projects.description_en: Squeek Raid is a browser-based pixel arcade game where players fly through rivers generated from Squeektoshi's recorded wheel runs. You steer, shoot cats, and collect seeds to survive five worlds, with daily routes changing based on the hamster's activity. The project features verified leaderboards for both practice and online play.
projects.name: Squeek Raid

projects.description_en: Seed Slash is a free browser arcade game where you swipe seeds and dodge bombs with Pip the hamster. The mobile-friendly experience features local artwork and sound, with optional Squeekchain wheel telemetry.
projects.name: Seed Slash

projects.description_en: Squeek Arena is a web-based platform that displays real-time telemetry from a physical hamster wheel, including speed and power output. Users can interact with the system by sending on-chain transactions to boost the wheel's speed or place wagers in a sprint betting game. The project also features a dynamic NFT that evolves based on the hamster's cumulative revolutions.
projects.name: SQUEEK ARENA

projects.description_en: Squeek Stream Kit is an OBS overlay and control panel for the Squeekchain hamster wheel. It displays live SPINNING and IDLE alerts, RPM, block progress, and round countdowns. The tool also supports viewer cheers to engage your audience.
projects.name: Squeek Stream Kit

projects.description_en: A single-player pixel-art economic game where you build a hamster-powered logistics outpost. You gather resources, craft items, and plan deliveries to grow your tiny industry. The gameplay connects to settled Squeekchain Genesis milestones.
projects.name: SQUEEK LOGISTICS

projects.description_en: Squeek Life is a pixel art life simulation game where you start as a broke rat and work your way up to the rich district. You scavenge for trash, take jobs, and upgrade your appearance to progress through three distinct city areas. The game runs in the browser and uses in-game coins, with wallet connection being optional.
projects.name: Squeek Life: From Rags to Riches

projects.description_en: Wheel Call lets you predict how hard the Squeekchain hamster will run in the next 10-minute round. You choose a speed band and compete against an Oracle that makes its own call with the same stake. Correct predictions earn seeds based on fixed odds, with results settled on-chain.
projects.name: Wheel Call

projects.description_en: A community road trip where a real hamster powers the journey. You watch the settled wheel distance and vote for the next stop among 64 destinations on Sepolia.
projects.name: Squeek’s First Road Trip

projects.description_en: Squeek Runner is a free 2D endless runner where you control a mouse jumping over pantry obstacles to collect cheese. The game supports keyboard and touch controls, allowing players to beat their local best score during short breaks.
projects.name: Squeek Runner

projects.description_en: Myth Arena is a turn-based PvP strategy game where players guess the order of eggs in their opponent's rack. The game uses zero-knowledge proofs to verify guesses and prevent tampering. Players compete to be the first to correctly identify the opponent's arrangement.
projects.name: Myth Arena

projects.description_en: Squeek Tales is a community-written story game where a hamster's adventures are determined by Squeekchain rounds. You choose the next chapter based on the work performed in the previous round, with different activity levels leading to different narrative outcomes. The project runs on Sepolia and offers daily test ETH rewards for participation.
projects.name: Squeek Tales

projects.description_en: Squeek Arena is an arcade fighting game featuring hamster characters. Players master high and low defense, aerial attacks, combos, throws, and special moves to battle opponents.
projects.name: SQUEEK ARENA

projects.description_en: Lock 30,000 test $MILES to join Squeektoshi's run on the Sepolia testnet. When the run ends, you receive your coins back and an on-chain card generated from the hamster's real running numbers.
projects.name: Run Cards

projects.description_en: A weekly browser game where players attack a boss whose health is determined by Squeekchain block progress. Damage is generated by the actual distance a hamster runs on its wheel, with different classes offering unique combat styles.
projects.name: Squeekchain Boss Raid

projects.description_en: Squeek Relay is a live arcade race where a real hamster powers the track. Players grab batons and build combos while riding Squeektoshi's energy. The hamster's activity changes the track, with running providing speed and sleep turning it to ice.
projects.name: Squeek Relay

projects.description_en: A free 45-second arcade game where you control a hamster to collect seeds and batteries while avoiding rocks. It supports both mobile and keyboard controls with a language toggle for English and Chinese.
projects.name: Hamster Dash

projects.description_en: Burrow is a financial district on Squeekchain where loans, bonds, and share tokens operate based on the activity of a real hamster wheel. Users can borrow against Squeek NFTs, purchase wheel bonds, or stake in Hamster Motors, with all terms tied to settled wheel work rather than real-time clocks.
projects.name: Burrow

projects.description_en: Squeek Play is a Squeekchain companion that lets you race Squeektoshi in a four-lane derby and follow live WHEELY9000 telemetry. It also includes tools to explore SqueekFi power and NFT merges, offering a playful way to interact with the hamster-powered ecosystem.
projects.name: Squeek Play

projects.description_en: SqueekPad is a launchpad on Squeekchain where token phases unlock based on settled Squeek blocks. Users can buy tokens from the first second, with Squeek holders receiving extra access during the initial hour. The platform features a fixed bonding curve, 0% tax, and burned liquidity.
projects.name: SqueekPad

projects.description_en: A browser game where you tap a tempo to trace the real speed curves of Squeektoshi's hamster-wheel runs. You match the amber line representing actual wheel data to earn stickers and track your daily streak. It is an unofficial fan project focused on rhythm and timing.
projects.name: Hamster Pacer: Echo

projects.description_en: Squeektoshi’s Diary tracks the daily activity of the hamster powering Squeekchain. It displays live wheel speed, distance, and historical pass counts to show how the animal contributes to the proof-of-work process on the Sepolia testnet.
projects.name: Squeektoshi’s Diary

projects.description_en: HamsterRun v3 is a free-to-mint on-chain game where players mint, feed, and train a hamster. The project features certified wheel training and racing mechanics without reward promises.
projects.name: HamsterRun

projects.description_en: Wheel Raid is a weekly boss fight where damage is calculated from Squeekchain's real round distance. You pick a role like DPS or Tank, then call RUN or SLEEP each round to predict the hamster's activity. Correct calls multiply your damage, and the team works together to defeat the boss before the week ends.
projects.name: Wheel Raid

projects.description_en: NEXORA is a space shooter where Squeektoshi's real wheel speed drives in-game overdrive and block drops. Players post their scores onchain to the $SQK contract on Sepolia, binding runs to specific Core rounds.
projects.name: NEXORA

projects.description_en: A read-only tool for planning Squeekchain staking actions on Sepolia. Look up a wallet to compare deposits, merges, and SQK stakes, then preview how these moves affect your power and rewards. The site generates unsigned calls for you to review in your own wallet without requesting signatures.
projects.name: Squeek Power Planner

projects.description_en: A one-button pixel arcade where you control Squeektoshi to collect seeds and dodge spikes. The game mirrors the live Squeekchain wheel, letting you see how many blocks you can mine in a session.
projects.name: Wheel Rush

projects.description_en: Squeek Turf is a strategy game where six factions compete for control of an underground map. Players use energy generated by Squeektoshi's wheel to claim territory, attack rivals, and strengthen their position. The game features a public leaderboard and a demo mode with bots to test the rules.
projects.name: Squeek Turf

projects.description_en: Squeek Pulse is a live dashboard for the Squeekchain network. It displays the hamster's wheel telemetry, block progress, and community rankings. The data refreshes every 20 seconds to show the chain's current activity.
projects.name: Squeek Pulse

projects.description_en: Squeekside is a read-only monitoring dashboard for Squeekchain that displays live Sepolia blocks, SqueekCore rounds, and hamster wheel progress. It offers custom themes, stream guides, and browser-local viewer predictions to help users follow the chain's activity.
projects.name: Squeekside

projects.description_en: Squeaksy is a pixel idle game where you wake a hamster to spin a wheel and fill block clouds. You earn stars to collect limited hamsters and Pixsy buddies while climbing the leaderboard. The game mirrors the real Squeekchain wheel, rewarding players with stars when actual blocks are confirmed on the chain.
projects.name: Squeaksy

projects.description_en: Squeek Dome is a non-custodial workbench for managing Squeeks on the Sepolia testnet. Users can inspect live holders, crank checkpoints, batch-claim SQK, and merge Squeeks using real wallet transactions.
projects.name: Squeek Dome

projects.description_en: Catch the Cheese is a one-button arcade game where you catch falling cheese wedges in a 60-second round. The game is powered by Squeektoshi's live wheel, which determines the speed and type of cheese drops. Catching cheese fills a snack meter, while misses break your streak.
projects.name: Catch the Cheese

projects.description_en: Squeek Beats is a rhythm game where you tap along to the real wheel passes of Squeektoshi, the hamster powering Squeekchain. You can play live to his current pace or replay a daily run, aiming for perfect timing within 60 milliseconds. The project lets you score your accuracy and share your results.
projects.name: Squeek Beats

projects.description_en: SQUEEKFOREST is a read-only pixel forest that grows trees based on confirmed Squeekchain blocks and live hamster wheel telemetry. The visual state changes with wheel speed, while stale or missing data is clearly disclosed to maintain transparency.
projects.name: SQUEEKFOREST

projects.description_en: Squeek Garden is a pixel garden where plants grow based on Squeektoshi's real wheel rounds. You plant seeds, manage barn animals, and collect goods to earn pips. The game includes skills, decorations, and daily challenges to track your progress.
projects.name: Squeek Garden

projects.description_en: Wheelhold is a persistent colony strategy game where Squeektoshi's verified wheel activity determines round outcomes. Players manage a personal colony whose fate is written by the hamster's real activity on the wheel.
projects.name: Wheelhold

projects.description_en: Squeek Warriors is a turn-based hamster RPG where the live Squeekchain wheel determines your party's stance. You fight battles that shift between Wheel frenzy and Burrow guard based on the hamster's real-time activity.
projects.name: Squeek Warriors

projects.description_en: Squeek Analytics provides read-only charts for the Squeek Chain public work record. It tracks work history, block milestones, settlement lag, and hamster performance on Ethereum Sepolia.
projects.name: Squeek Analytics

projects.description_en: Squeek Colony is a free cooperative pixel game where players build a shared hamster burrow. Each ten-minute Squeekchain round, you choose to Forage, Fortify, or Research, with the official wheel result settling your progress. The game reads public chain data to drive its mechanics.
projects.name: Squeek Colony

projects.description_en: A set of free browser overlays and a viewer game for Squeekchain streams. Viewers predict Squeektoshi's next wheel movement, while the stream displays an LED board, alerts, and a leaderboard. The kit includes scenes and a ticker for OBS and Streamlabs.
projects.name: Squeek Stream Kit
